bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Preview independent Editor prerequisite and initial God installer. Resolves the latest compatible published God release and freezes its verified commit. Supports long Windows input paths, reports fingerprint read errors and completes cached-only incremental compilation without waiting for a reload. Visual/keyboard acceptance remains incomplete under explicit user instruction.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Commandments Compatibility
bricks.description: Passive Editor API compatibility adapter for existing Companion installations. God 0.29.0 owns Commandments tools; fresh projects do not need this adapter.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge God
bricks.description: Game Forge God package management, installed tools embedded inside God with pinned Back navigation, Build Forge setup, optional Commandments Companion integration, lifecycle, settings and optional scene-startup/input cooperation.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Diagnostics
bricks.description: God-owned runtime logging, Quantum Console channels and commands, session history, health checks, read-only inspection, Windows performance metrics and Odin Editor tooling.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Settings System
bricks.description: Preview: three-step beginner Editor setup with simple starters, current-state completion checks and advanced Odin configuration, plus transactional settings, explicit Apply/Cancel, persistence and optional providers. Native visual/input acceptance remains pending.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Scene Loading and Bootstrap
bricks.description: Bootstrap-first startup, scene groups, asset-authored later scene changes and reusable loading presentations, readiness and recovery, with optional UI Foundations callbacks, pooling lifecycle and multiplayer integration points.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Save and Load
bricks.description: Starter package with an Editor main menu describing planned shared saving and loading support. Runtime save and load functionality is not implemented.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Audio
bricks.description: Shared owned playback, Unity-default clips and separate optional FMOD events/banks. One Audio workspace with separate integration steps, information callouts, green accents, shared volume controls and native authoring. Focused Editor checks passed; rendered UI acceptance remains pending.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge User Interface Foundations
bricks.description: Preview: Panel Renderer menu hosts with explicit Undo-supported legacy upgrades, editable creation drafts, shared appearance and optional Settings controls. Native input and visual acceptance remain pending.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Object Pooling
bricks.description: Reusable prefab pools with generation-checked leases, prewarming, reset and completion handling, diagnostics and optional scene lifecycle cooperation. Supports God neutral participants; optional FMOD completion and setup belong to Audio.
